name: Cta
description: Call-to-action banner with eyebrow, a two-tone headline (light line + bold line), body text, and up to two buttons — or an inline name+email form. Backgrounds: soft brand, dark, or a full-bleed image.
when_to_use: Conversion moments mid-page or before the footer. Use the inline-form variant for lightweight lead capture; use Contact for a full contact section, and Hero for page openers.
capabilities: two-tone headline: light-weight first line + bold second line
up to two buttons with on-dark variants (white-solid, outline-white)
inline form with name + email + submit and a small note (inline-form variant)
full-bleed background image with text overlay (fullbleed-image variant)

variants.description: Text left, button right on a soft brand background. Default.
Centered text on a dark background — pair with white-solid / outline-white buttons.
Text over the background_image with a scrim.
Name + email + submit form instead of buttons; uses the form_* fields.

breakpoints.mobile: Stacked; buttons and form fields go full width.
breakpoints.desktop: Split variant places text and actions side by side.

ai.prompt_summary: Cta: conversion banner. Settings: variant (split|center-dark|fullbleed-image|inline-form), eyebrow, title_light (light-weight line), title_bold (bold line), body; fullbleed-image only: background_image; inline-form only: form_name_label, form_mail_label, form_submit_label, form_note. buttons[] (max 2 — primary first, optional secondary second; ignored by inline-form): { label, to, target, color (primary|secondary), variant (solid|outline|ghost|white-solid|outline-white), button_size, icon, leading, trailing, block }.
ai.content_guidelines: Headline lines 2-5 words each; body at most 2 sentences. Primary button first. On center-dark and fullbleed-image use white-solid or outline-white button variants.

field_hints.title_light: First headline line, rendered in light weight — set up the bold line.
field_hints.form_note: Small reassurance line below submit, e.g. privacy hint.
